statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-77421 (GHSA-ph9c-7hw9-vhhw): the nano editor built into JLine's jline-builtins module passes the user's regular-expression search term from Nano.doSearch to Java's backtracking regex engine without any bound, so a nested-quantifier pattern can tie up the editor session's thread indefinitely. It affects jline-builtins 3.0.0 before 3.30.15 and 4.0.0 before 4.3.1, and is fixed in 3.30.15 and 4.3.1; the 4.x fix is jline3 pull request 2012 on the master branch (commit 1d5fc3099e77938b971e197211cad2d4fbb17541), from which 4.3.1 is tagged (https://github.com/jline/jline3/security/advisories/GHSA-ph9c-7hw9-vhhw, https://github.com/jline/jline3/pull/2012, https://github.com/jline/jline3/commit/1d5fc3099e77938b971e197211cad2d4fbb17541, https://github.com/jline/jline3/releases/tag/4.3.1). Unpacked all 25 published activemq-artemis packages in the DHI Debian repository, 2.55.0-0 through the current 2.57.0-9, for amd64 and arm64 (2.57.0-0 was published for arm64 only; no debug-symbol packages are published for this source, and none is in the DHI security repository), including every file inside the jar archives they bundle, among them those under the web console's console.war directory. Builds 2.55.0-0 and 2.55.0-1 bundle the JLine 4.2.1 jars (jline-builtins, jline-console, jline-console-ui, jline-reader, jline-shell, jline-style and jline-terminal) under /usr/share/activemq-artemis/lib. From 2.56.0-0 every build, through 2.57.0-9, bundles JLine 4.3.1 instead, by the jars' Maven metadata; no build carries JLine in the web console. Searching the contents of every jar archive in every build, the JLine nano editor class org/jline/builtins/Nano.class appears only in the bundled jline-builtins jar. So 2.56.0-0 is the first fixed build.
